fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Location

fields.label: Psc Interface Config
Network Attachment
fields.help: Fully qualified name of the Network Attachment that DMS will connect to.
The PSC Interface configuration is used to create PSC Interface between DMS's internal VPC and the consumer's PSC.

fields.label: VPC Peering Config
VPC Name
fields.help: Fully qualified name of the VPC that Database Migration Service will peer to.
The VPC Peering configuration is used to create VPC peering between databasemigrationservice and the consumer's VPC.
